# Company
> AdvanseIT is a Brisbane-based IT company (ABN 12 656 409 850) that builds websites, mobile apps, custom software, and AI solutions for Australian businesses. Founded and operated in Queensland, Australia.

## Services

- Web Design & Development: Responsive, SEO-optimised websites built with React, Next.js, and modern frameworks. Fixed-price quotes. URL: https://advanseit.com.au/services/web-design
- App Development: Custom iOS and Android mobile applications, cross-platform apps using React Native. URL: https://advanseit.com.au/services/app-development
- Custom Software Development: Bespoke enterprise software, API integrations, SaaS platforms. URL: https://advanseit.com.au/services/custom-software
- AI Solutions: AI integrations, chatbots, machine learning models, process automation, and AI-first software. URL: https://advanseit.com.au/services/ai-solutions
- Software Testing & QA: Manual, automated (Selenium, Playwright), performance, and security testing. URL: https://advanseit.com.au/services/testing
- IT Staffing & Outsourcing: Skilled developer, tester, and IT professional placement across Australia. URL: https://advanseit.com.au/services/it-staffing
